items.author: Aigerim T.
items.text: I booked a general cleaning before my parents arrived. The team showed up on time and did a thorough job — I was especially happy with the kitchen, the hood and oven looked brand new. Will book again.

items.author: Daniyar K.
items.text: Post-renovation cleaning was exactly what we needed. We would've spent a week wiping down dust ourselves — they got the apartment ready for the furniture in a single day.

items.author: Svetlana V.
items.text: I've been using biweekly maintenance cleaning for a few months now. Overall I'm happy — once I had to ask them to re-mop a floor, and they redid it the same day, no questions asked.

items.author: Maksim O.
items.text: We booked office cleaning in the evening after closing — staff walked into a clean, fresh space the next morning. We've been on a recurring plan for two months now.

items.author: Gulnara A.
items.text: The sofa dry cleaning exceeded expectations — marker stains from the kids that seemed permanent are completely gone. The sofa looks like it just came from the store.

items.author: Viktor P.
items.text: They washed the windows on the balcony and in every room — not a single streak, I was genuinely surprised. Showed up on time and worked quickly and carefully.

items.author: Nurgul Zh.
items.text: I booked cleaning after moving — the apartment had been empty for a while and there was a lot of dust. Everything ended up spotless, it just took a bit longer than we initially expected.
